name: anzrag's rampage
mana cost: {3}{R}{R}
types: sorcery
spell[1]: destroy all artifacts you don't control, then exile the top X cards of your library, where X is the number of artifacts that were put into graveyards from the battlefield this turn.
spell[2]: you may put a creature card exiled this way onto the battlefield. it gains haste. return it to your hand at the beginning of the next end step.
